name: Summer Pleasure
source:
Everything is ready! The vacation you and your two best friends have been waiting for forever, and planning for months, is about to begin! A crazy week on a gorgeous tropical island, in a magnificent beach resort, with a luxurious private apartment all to yourselves! But, as in the worst stories, your two friends ruin everything, and you are left alone.... What to do? Stay home amid regrets? Or go off on an adventure alone, at the risk of meeting four gorgeous girls, four goddesses, who need help because their reservation has been lost? Angelique, Lexie, Louise and Susie can stay in your super private apartment: will they be able to find a way to repay you for such generosity? Flirts, sex and friendship become intertwined in SUMMER PLEASURES!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2080240/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一切都准备就绪！你和两位挚友期待已久、筹划数月的假期即将开始！在美丽的热带岛屿上，于豪华海滨度假村和专属公寓里，尽情享受疯狂的一周！然而，正如最糟糕的故事那样，两位朋友把一切都搞砸了，只留下你独自一人……该怎么办？待在家里后悔？还是独自踏上冒险，冒着遇见4位绝色美女、4位女神的风险？她们因为预订丢失而需要帮助。Angelique、Lexie、Louise和Susie可以住进你的私人公寓；她们会用什么方式报答你的慷慨呢？调情、性爱与友情在《Summer Pleasure》中交织！

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2080240/]Steam[/url]]
